preconditions.description: Attacker must be the contract owner

exploit_hint: As the contract owner, call excludeFromFees() or excludeMultipleAccountsFromFees() to exclude your address from transaction fees. This allows you to bypass the 1% additional fee when selling to automated market maker pairs, giving you an unfair advantage over other users. You can also use setExcludeFromAll() to exclude from both fees and dividends.
